english.note: Use this when someone is fussy or hard to please, especially about food or other choices.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is fussy or particular.

examples.english: They are very particular; when eating, they always pick the best ones.
examples.traditional: 佢好揀擇，食飯一定要揀最靚嗰啲。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 gaan2 zaak6 sik6 faan6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaan2 zeoi3 leng3 go2 di1

examples.english: They are very picky when buying clothes; if it is not to their liking, they will not buy it.
examples.traditional: 佢買衫好揀擇，唔係啱心水就唔買。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 maai5 saam1 hou2 gaan2 zaak6 m4 hai6 ngaam1 sam1 seoi2 zau6 m4 maai5
